weaknesses.issue: Opening explains a promise before demonstrating the correction mechanism.
The before/after text change is not emphasized enough to make causality immediate.
Peer and host roles are prepared fictional examples, not a live community.
Consent is shown as an unchecked disabled form, without a subsequent decision branch.
No provider is bookable and the ending has no lived consequence or family resolution.
Audio could not be heard, limiting narration, sound mix, and pacing assessment.
Persistent top status band overlays webpage content and partially obscures interface text.

fix_tickets.replacement: Show a clearly fictional tentative reflection followed by user correction; retain privacy as caption.
fix_tickets.expected_result: The core mechanism is clear sooner.
fix_tickets.later_film_verification: Ask a cold viewer to describe the mechanism after 15 seconds.

fix_tickets.current_issue: Before/after change is easy to miss.
fix_tickets.replacement: Show old and updated reflections side by side, highlight changed words, and keep the status band clear of page text.
fix_tickets.expected_result: Correction reads causally without visual overlap.
fix_tickets.later_film_verification: Ask viewers what changed and what followed.

fix_tickets.current_issue: Peer and host roles are text-only proposals.
fix_tickets.replacement: Retain fictional label, condense boundary card, and mark human role as proposed.
fix_tickets.expected_result: Role value is clear without implying live members.
fix_tickets.later_film_verification: Check that viewers distinguish prepared sample from live community.

fix_tickets.current_issue: Consent appears as a disabled form rather than a decision branch.
fix_tickets.replacement: Show review of exact text and audience, unchecked consent, disabled control, and return to private reflection.
fix_tickets.expected_result: No-send state is easy to understand.
fix_tickets.later_film_verification: Ask what is excluded and why nothing transmits.

fix_tickets.replacement: Tighten provider limitation, then end on the private takeaway and a clear exit.
fix_tickets.later_film_verification: Ask what Arjun gains and what remains unresolved.

release_recommendation: Advance only to prototype validation; do not present this film as evidence of a live service. Keep model, community, provider, and messaging roles labeled proposed or unavailable.
